---
title: "Share an Idea"
subtitle: "A simple way to contribute before the BENQODHI workshop"
body-class: contribution-page
---

Before the workshop, we invite participants to leave short ideas that can help shape
the discussion at JRC Ispra. This can be a candidate benchmark problem, a suggestion
for the working session, a question for the panel, or a practical note about datasets,
metrics or baselines.

This is intentionally lightweight. You do not need a polished proposal or a long
document. A few clear sentences are enough.

::: {.contribution-call}
::: {.contribution-call-text}
## Leave a Short Note

Submit one idea at a time. The organisers will read the notes before the workshop and
use them to prepare the working session and discussion.
:::

::: {.contribution-call-action}
[Submit an idea](https://github.com/ocadni/benqodhi/issues/new?template=workshop-contribution.yml){.primary-action}
:::
:::

## Where Ideas Live

Ideas are collected as public GitHub Issues in the BENQODHI repository. Each issue is
just one short contribution.

::: {.read-links}
[Read submitted ideas](https://github.com/ocadni/benqodhi/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aworkshop-idea){.secondary-action}
:::

If GitHub is inconvenient, send your idea by email:
[JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu](mailto:JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu)

## What Kind of Idea?

::: {.contribution-grid}
::: {.contribution-card}
::: {.goal-number}
01
:::
### Session Organisation

How should the small working session be organised? Which themes should be discussed
together? What would make the session useful?
:::

::: {.contribution-card}
::: {.goal-number}
02
:::
### Panel Discussion

Suggest a question that should be asked during the panel or closing discussion.
:::

::: {.contribution-card}
::: {.goal-number}
03
:::
### Candidate Problems

Propose a health or biology optimization problem that could be discussed as a possible
BENQODHI benchmark.
:::

::: {.contribution-card}
::: {.goal-number}
04
:::
### Practical Notes

Suggest useful datasets, baselines, metrics, software, references or related benchmark
initiatives.
:::
:::

## How to Contribute

Use the GitHub form:

1. Open the [idea form](https://github.com/ocadni/benqodhi/issues/new?template=workshop-contribution.yml).
2. Choose the type of idea.
3. Write a short description.
4. Add optional links or references.

That is all. The organisers will collect the ideas before the workshop.

## If You Propose a Problem

If your idea is a candidate benchmark problem, please mention:

- what the biological or health use case is,
- what needs to be optimized,
- what data or instances might be available,
- why the problem is hard or interesting,
- which baselines or metrics could be useful.

Partial sketches are welcome.
